movies.title: Dumbo
movies.summary: A young elephant, whose oversized ears enable him to fly, helps save a struggling circus, but when the circus plans a new venture, Dumbo and his friends discover dark secrets beneath its shiny veneer.

movies.title: The Invisible Man
movies.summary: When Cecilia's abusive ex takes his own life and leaves her his fortune, she suspects his death was a hoax. As a series of coincidences turn lethal, Cecilia works to prove that she is being hunted by someone nobody can see.

movies.title: Prisoners
movies.summary: A desperate father takes the law into his own hands after police fail to find two kidnapped girls.

movies.title: Leyla ile Mecnun
movies.summary: A fortune-teller reveals the Sultan that his daughter will get married to somebody poor, born on the same day with her. So, the Sultan gets all the baby boys born on the same day are killed and only Kadir is saved. Kadir and Leyla grow up together.

movies.title: Karilar Kogusu
movies.summary: Murat is a charismatic political prisoner in Malatya. He is well respected by both inmates and prison officers. There he meets two women: Tozey, a famous prostitute, and Hanim, a defenseless woman accused of murdering her husband.

movies.title: Deti noci
movies.summary: A store clerk (Martha Issová) becomes depressed after her boyfriend (Jan Dolanský) dumps her for her best friend (Kristýna Nováková).

movies.title: Melody
movies.summary: A homeless hairdresser agrees to to act as a surrogate womb in exchange for enough money to achieve her dream of a salon in a town called Melody.

movies.title: Lucky Jo
movies.summary: Jo the gangster has the formidable gift of bringing down the worst kind of catastrophes on the heads of his best friends. Thus everything would be perfect if Simon hadn't lent his car to Jo.

movies.title: Dehset Gecesi
movies.summary: A raped woman tries to prove her innocence and catch the criminals.

movies.title: Master of Dark Shadows
movies.summary: Master of Dark Shadows reveals the fascinating impact of the ground-breaking Gothic drama Dark Shadows and award-winning filmmaker Dan Curtis.

movies.title: Zengo
movies.summary: A housewife with a big passion for fashion and with the help of her tailor Fazilet, she is turning her ideas into reality, but she gets competition from her school day friend and rival Menkibe.

movies.title: Schumacher '94: Die Geburt einer Legende
movies.summary: Follows 25-year-old Michael Schumacher's breakthrough 1994 Formula 1 season, featuring his first Grand Prix win in Brazil and the dramatic events of one of F1's most exciting racing seasons, including Ayrton Senna's accident.

movies.title: Doing Life
movies.summary: A single mother fighting to survive and a reformed ex-con with untapped talent find in each other an unlikely second chance.

movies.title: Veda busesi
movies.summary: A melodrama set in a huge villa most of the time, the beautiful young son has his face atrociously disfigured, his dominant mother tries to find him a bride, lots of music and opulent cinematography too.

movies.title: Kadin berberi
movies.summary: Lale is the only daughter of a wealthy family and inherits all her parents' money and property. On a boat tour, she meets Erol the hair dresser. In the beginning they feel attracted to each other but all this ends as she belittles him for his job. Erol's customers are all his fans. Lale calls Erol home, introducing her maid Suna as the landlady while she takes the role of a pedicurist. Erol and Lale get together again yet this time her cousin Cemil wants to marry her to share her wealth. Cemil tells Erol about it so, he leaves Lale. Cemil and his mother make a plot to kill Lale. Luckily Suna has been eavesdropping and informs Erol right away. Erol reaches home just before Cemil poisons Lale and saves her. The police arrest Cemil. Cemil's mother drinks the poisoned milk, which she has prepared for Lale. In the end Lale and Erol, Suna and Erol's friend Tayfur marry.

movies.title: Benim De Kalbim Var
movies.summary: Selma works as a maid at Nurettin Bey's house. As the family goes on vacation to Europe, Selma plays the role of the landlady and hires a driver, Murat. Selma meets Kenan who is after her fortune. As Murat tells her about Kenan's real intentions, she doesn't believe him.

movies.title: Baba Bizi Eversene
movies.summary: A hopelessly yearning hippie is left alone with a newborn baby when his just married parents go for a vacation, but wittily he finds a solution to get back his expatriate girlfriend, utilizing the baby who has no idea what is going on.

movies.title: Cold November
movies.summary: The archivist Fadili finds himself in a difficult situation, with an impossible choice of two options, fully aware that both of them are wrong. As a consequence of his decision Fadil involuntarily and unwillingly, has to swallow the shame.

movies.title: Mountains of the Moon
movies.summary: Chris Benchetler's Mountains of the Moon explores the unseen connections between sport, life, music, and the living earth—set to the timeless tunes of the Grateful Dead. Captured almost entirely at night using cutting-edge cinematography, the film takes viewers on a surreal journey through ocean, river, and mountain landscapes while featuring some of the world's greatest athletes, adventurers and thinkers. Skiing, Snowboarding, Surfing, Climbing, Mountain Biking and Mushrooms. Narrated by Mycologist, Paul Stamets.

movies.title: Stranglehold
movies.summary: Fed up with their lives, barely eking by in small-town Arkansas, a stripper with dreams and her Army vet husband decide to rob the strip club that employs her.

movies.title: Infirmary
movies.summary: A guard vanished on his first night at an old psych hospital in 2023. His bodycam footage shows unexplainable incidents that continue to baffle investigators.

movies.title: Union County
movies.summary: Assigned to a county-mandated drug court program, Cody Parsons embarks on the tenuous journey toward recovery amidst the opioid epidemic in rural Ohio.

movies.title: The Last First: Winter K2
movies.summary: K2's first winter ascent claimed 5 lives, revealing modern alpinism's struggles with commercialization, social media impact, and conflicts between marginalized climbers and traditional elites.

movies.title: Adam's Curse: Reborn from Hell
movies.summary: Stripped of the inverted cross by a group of mercenaries, Adam is now an empty shell. He must ally with a father and son seeking revenge and defeat the King of Trash and his gang of slavers in order to be reborn and regain his powers.

movies.title: Siren
movies.summary: Strange goings on ensue, when a few friends on a sailboat find an island with a beautiful lone female inhabitant.

movies.title: Buzzkill
movies.summary: Follows a group of sorority sisters who end up trapped with a murderer. Nora's tipsy memories hold the clues to figuring out who is killing their friends, but she can only remember them when she's drunk.

movies.title: Shootfighter: Fight to the Death
movies.summary: Fight matches, that end when a man is either unconscious or dead, are fought in Tijuana. 2 naive friends, hoping to make a quick buck, go there. One owes money to a loan shark - giving them plenty of practice in no rule fights.

movies.title: Top of the World
movies.summary: Set inside Windows on the World, the legendary restaurant atop the World Trade Center.

movies.title: Candy Stripers
movies.summary: After a car crash, Tammy and injured basketball players are hospitalized. When a nurse kisses dying Tammy, an alien infection spreads through the hospital staff and patients. The facility is quarantined as infected people seek sugar.

movies.title: Death Orchard
movies.summary: A lovelorn hex from the past haunts a rural town as two sisters uncover deadly secrets that will bind them to the family orchard forever.

movies.title: Monica se întoarce
movies.summary: While standing in front of her boyfriend's apartment, Monica hears him having sex with another girl. Suddenly, everything appears clear for her. Or not.

movies.title: Pay or Die
movies.summary: An underworld kingpin's daughter is kidnapped by his own men. So, he calls in Cleopatra Wong, a beautiful karate queen. She brings a team with her - a 300+ pound psychic and a female impersonator.

movies.title: L'assassin connaît la musique...
movies.summary: Lionel Fribourg, a great composer (at least that's what HE thinks) has a problem with his noisy environment: he can't complete his unfinished symphony. Of course there is a market for unfinished symphonies but, for all he knows, only one became famous. So he had better find a way to finish it. At long last, he comes across Agnes, a divorced woman who agrees to let him her quiet home. Lionel, full of hope, resumes work...

movies.title: She Did It
movies.summary: After a suicide attempt, a fragile young woman awakens to find her boyfriend claiming her dead body is in their bathtub.

movies.title: Doll of Deceit
movies.summary: A woman's affair with a hired handyman takes a dark turn when her husband discovers the betrayal, leading to a suspenseful tale of captivity and an eerie transformation that blurs the line between reality and nightmare. Who will survive?

movies.title: La strada per Forte Alamo
movies.summary: A lone rider comes across a dying soldier, who gives him a paper authorizing the payment of $150,000 to the U.S. Army. The rider gathers some colleagues who disguise themselves as soldiers and who take the paper to a bank.

movies.title: The Last Reckoning
movies.summary: A prestigious attorney colludes with his impulsive brother to hide a manslaughter, but when an innocent is charged, their plans spiral out of control, leading to moral reckoning and inevitable judgment.

movies.title: Hell Is Other People
movies.summary: Yu feels hopeless in rural life. Impulsively visiting his girlfriend in Tokyo, he ends up staying at "Eden," a cheap lodging with odd residents. After one vanishes, Yu suspects they may be killing newcomers. Can he escape safely?

movies.title: Last Reckoning
movies.summary: Dan's life takes a turn when a duffel bag full of cash is mistakenly placed in his trunk. Now he has to choose whether to return the money to keep his family and friends safe, or to run and save himself.

movies.title: Accursed
movies.summary: When a nun's cursed secret resurfaces on Emma's 21st birthday, a lake-house reunion turns deadly. A masked cult and dark prophecy force Emma and her friends to face possession, betrayal, and a midnight ritual that could raise ancient evil.

movies.title: Dracula Revamped
movies.summary: A local theatre troupe sets out to make their own movie version of Dracula, but their charismatic leader may be more than just an inspiring director-he could be a real blood-sucking vampire. As rehearsals turn sinister, the lines between performance and reality blur, leading to a delightfully dark and unpredictable finale.

movies.title: Jackie the Stripper
movies.summary: A female empowerment grind house comedy action thriller. Jackie and her band of female vigilante assassins hatch a plan to kill six members of the evil male dominated court. With deadly and hilarious consequences

movies.title: Nightfall: A Paranormal Investigation
movies.summary: The year is 1988. Paranormal investigators Mick Sutherland and Archie Charlesworth have built their careers on confronting the unexplained across Northern Europe. But when a desperate call draws them to the isolated home of Elizabeth Blair, they encounter a presence unlike anything they've faced before. Over seven days, this force begins to unravel their sanity, twisting their perception of reality itself and threatening to destroy their bond. This is no ordinary haunting. This is Case 13.

movies.title: Locker
movies.summary: On a dive to the wreck of the Titanic, the crew of the Orion submersible become trapped on the ocean floor. Marcus Graves, his son David, social media influencer Jackson, and Titanic enthusiast Alejo embark on the perilous journey.

movies.title: Working in the Dark
movies.summary: Kim tries to get a modeling contract to start her career. A death changes everything and forces Kim to try unconditional methods in dark places to get on a magazine cover.

movies.title: Why Women Trip
movies.summary: Wearing her heart on her sleeve, Zori Johnson is consistently hurt in relationships. However, a new love interest entices her to open up her heart again but it is it the right move?

movies.title: Harbinger
movies.summary: Julia, sole survivor of late serial killer Decker, is lured back to the house she shared with him for a ghost hunting TV show. The crew discover the 'Harbinger' - a fairground fortune telling machine that reveals their fates one by one.

movies.title: Ohh My Dog
movies.summary: A young child forms an unexpected bond with a stray dog, embarking on an adventure that reveals the profound ways animals and humans can heal each other's hearts.

movies.title: Le chant des forêts
movies.summary: A journey of uncommon beauty into the heart of wild forests.

movies.title: Vaazha II: Biopic of a Billion Bros
movies.summary: Four friends labeled as losers and troublemakers embark on an emotional journey of self-discovery as they face mounting social pressure. They learn to embrace their responsibilities and find success on their own terms.

movies.title: Dance for Your Life
movies.summary: Ten young Australian dancers from Brent Street performing arts school compete for a spot with an international dance company, traveling to London to audition for Shapehaus Dance Theatre under choreographer Dean Lee.

movies.title: Yanni Live! The Concert Event
movies.summary: This spectacular and mesmerizing live event was captured by 16 hi-definition cameras and 125 channels of digital audio for a brilliant and amazing clear audio-visual experience. Go center stage for an explosive concert filled with stunning performances by the world's most extraordinary musicians.

movies.title: The Day of the Doctor
movies.summary: In 2013, something terrible is awakening in London's National Gallery; in 1562, a murderous plot is afoot in Elizabethan England; and somewhere in space an ancient battle reaches its devastating conclusion.

movies.title: Avenged Sevenfold: Live in the L.B.C. & Diamonds in the Rough
movies.summary: Avenged Sevenfold recorded their first live DVD at Long Beach Arena.

movies.title: Mexican Wave
movies.summary: Documentary that follows a group of London-based Mexicans campaigning for democracy, human rights and fighting for an answer to the forced disappearances of 43 agricultural students in September 2014 and the routine murder of students, journalists and activists, as well as the political system in Mexico around this situation.

movies.title: Twenty One Pilots: More Than We Ever Imagined
movies.summary: Twenty One Pilots' concert film captures their massive Mexico City show at Estadio GNP Seguros, blending explosive performances with backstage moments as they prepare for 65,000 fans during The Clancy World Tour.

movies.title: CMYLMZ
movies.summary: The funny little details of everyday life; the simple things that makes us laugh. An unforgettable performance from Cem Yilmaz.

movies.title: Pink Floyd: P. U. L. S. E. Live at Earls Court
movies.summary: Pink Floyd's final live show in 1994.

movies.title: Where the Light Is: John Mayer Live in Concert
movies.summary: John Mayer performs at Nokia Theatre in Los Angeles, California on December 8, 2007, during his promotional tour for his third album, Continuum. The show consists of three separate performances, one from John Mayer alone, then from the John Mayer Trio, and ending with John Mayer and his full touring ensemble.

movies.title: The Warning Live from Auditorio Nacional, CDMX
movies.summary: Three sisters who form the rock band The Warning deliver an explosive concert at Mexico City's legendary Auditorio Nacional, showcasing their fierce talent and deep family connection.

movies.title: Bluey
movies.summary: Bluey, a playful six-year-old Blue Heeler puppy, turns everyday family life with her parents and little sister Bingo into imaginative games and heartfelt adventures.

movies.title: Life
movies.summary: A global nature documentary exploring the extraordinary strategies animals and plants use to survive, reproduce, and thrive across Earth's diverse habitats.

movies.title: Planet Earth III
movies.summary: Discover amazing landscapes, the most amazing fights of animals on our planet, from the highest mountains to the deepest oceans, from the darkest caves to the hottest deserts with new technology.

movies.title: Raye at the Royal Albert Hall
movies.summary: Raye performs at the prestigious Royal Albert Hall following her breakthrough debut album.

movies.title: Hababam Sinifi
movies.summary: Lazy, uneducated students share a very close bond. They live together in the dormitory, where they plan their latest pranks. When a new headmaster arrives, the students naturally try to overthrow him. A comic war of nitwits follows.

movies.title: Ramayana: The Legend of Prince Rama
movies.summary: An anime adaptation of the Hindu epic the Ramayana, where Lord Ram combats the wicked king Ravana.

movies.title: Stargazer: Astroscope
movies.summary: Like a dark night sky kissed by starlight, will ASTRO chase away the darkness and greet the welcoming wave of AROHA violet?

movies.title: National Theatre Live: Prima Facie
movies.summary: Tessa is a young, brilliant barrister. From working class origins, she has reached the top of her game. An unexpected event forces her to confront the lines where the patriarchal power of the law, burden of proof and morals diverge.

movies.title: All My Friends: Celebrating the Songs & Voice of Gregg Allman
movies.summary: All My Friends: Celebrating The Songs and Voice Of Gregg Allman captures a once-in-a-lifetime performance honoring one of the most acclaimed and beloved icons in rock and roll history. A founding member of the Allman Brothers Band and successful solo artist in his own right, Allman possesses a voice that has resonated through four decades. The concert features momentous performances by Warren Haynes, Derek Trucks, Susan Tedeschi, Devon Allman, Robert Randolph, Jimmy Hall, Sam Moore, Keb Mo, Brantley Gilbert, Jess Franklin, Dr. John, Pat Monahan, John Hiatt, Jaimoe, Taj Mahal, Gregg Allman, Widespread Panic, Trace Adkins, Vince Gill, Martina McBride, Eric Church, Jackson Brown, Zak Brown, and The Allman Brothers Band with musical direction by Don Was. Shot in high definition with 5:1 Dolby sound at the historic Fox Theatre in Atlanta this remarkable piece pays tribute to a voice that once heard is never forgotten.

movies.title: Hans Zimmer: Live in Prague
movies.summary: The renowned film score composer leads a concert featuring his cinematic compositions.

movies.title: Africa Special, Part 1
movies.summary: In the first of a two-part Top Gear special, Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May are in Africa with a simple mission - to find the definitive source of the Nile. Over the years many explorers claim to have already done just that, but the Top Gear trio believe that they can do better by traveling using only grit, ingenuity and three ageing estate cars.

movies.title: Blackberry Smoke: Leave a Scar Live
Bring Me the Horizon: L.I.V.E. in São Paulo
movies.summary: The band's best show yet, this film expands POST HUMAN's visual world with high-end production, fan perspectives, and iconic characters E.V.E, Selene, and M8. Multi-camera footage, drones, and fan videos create an immersive experience.

movies.title: Gülizar
movies.summary: Gülizar is a beautiful young girl. She was engaged to a young man from her village without her consent. Her fiance went to work in Istanbul. One day, the fate of Gülizar changes after the arrival of a new teacher to her village.

movies.title: CM101MMXI Fundamentals
movies.summary: The funny little details of everyday life; the simple things that makes us laugh. An unforgettable performance from Cem Yilmaz. Yilmaz captures the audience with his hilarious stories about relationships, humankind's struggle with the technology and professional life. Yilmaz proves us that a food delivery or even a funeral might be amusing when considered correctly.

movies.title: Pink Floyd: The Dark Side of the Moon (50th Anniversary Box Set)
movies.summary: This is just a remake of the classic LP album by Pink Floyd. Excellent quality and sound. No actual video like in a concert. Just the music.

movies.title: The Godfather Part II
movies.summary: The early life and career of Vito Corleone in 1920s New York City is portrayed, while his son, Michael, expands and tightens his grip on the family crime syndicate.

movies.title: Schindler's List
movies.summary: In German-occupied Poland during World War II, industrialist Oskar Schindler gradually becomes concerned for his Jewish workforce after witnessing their persecution by the Nazis.

movies.title: 12 Angry Men
movies.summary: The jury in a New York City murder trial is frustrated by a single member whose skeptical caution forces them to more carefully consider the evidence before jumping to a hasty verdict.

movies.title: Nightwish: Showtime, Storytime
movies.summary: 2013 live release from the Finnish Symphonic Metal band. Recorded during their live performance at the Wacken Open Air in Wacken, Germany on August 3, 2013.

movies.title: No Festival: A Concert for No One
movies.summary: Launched on the date of what should've been the first day of this year's Electric Castle, No Festival is the documented story of an intimate experience created as a metaphor that marks the state of an industry deeply impacted by the Covid-19 pandemic. Three of the most beloved Romanian bands (Vita de Vie, Golan, and Subcarpati) for the first time on the same stage. Apart and together. A concert for no one. A concert for everyone.

movies.title: Apocalypse: La 2ème guerre mondiale
movies.summary: This six-part series traces the Second World War, from the rise of the Nazis to the surrender of the Japanese, with detailed portraits of key figures.

movies.title: The Blue Planet
movies.summary: Explores Earth's oceans, from sunlit shallows to the deep sea, revealing the animals, habitats, and forces that shape life beneath the waves.

movies.title: Heilung - Lifa (Live at Castlefest)
movies.summary: Recorded on a late summer night at Castlefest 2017 in The Netherlands, 'Lifa' captures the first-ever live performance of HEILUNG. 'Lifa' lays bare the power and majesty of the enigmatic Danish trios deeply ritualistic live performance for all to experience.

movies.title: David Attenborough: A Life on Our Planet
movies.summary: In this documentary David Attenborough, the celebrated naturalist, reflects upon both the defining moments of his lifetime and the devastating changes he has seen. The film provides a snapshot of global nature loss in a single lifetime.

movies.title: The Killers: Live from the Royal Albert Hall
movies.summary: In July, 2009, the Killers set out to create a gift for their fans...a spectacular concert experience, at a uniquely majestic venue, featuring their greatest songs - filmed with pristine production values, for the bands first ever official live concert release. Includes the complete show with all the fan favorites performed live!

movies.title: Nature's Great Events
movies.summary: This exploration of the planet's most breathtaking natural events follows vast migrations, huge ocean convergences, powerful weather systems and mighty floods.

movies.title: Yesterday Was Everything
movies.summary: A band struggles to reconcile for a reunion tour a decade after a contentious break-up and a fatal accident.

movies.title: Puscifer: Parole Violator
movies.summary: This is a live soundtrack to the recent Puscifer Pay Per View, filmed and recorded at the Wiltern Theatre in Los Angeles. It features new live recordings of the classic album "Conditions of my Parole".

movies.title: Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band: Live in New York City
movies.summary: Live From New York City is the chronicle of Bruce Springsteen's first tour with The E Street Band in over a decade. A full-on rock revival packed with hits and fan favorites, Live From New York is a triumphant reunion of one of rock's great acts.

movies.title: A Bee's Diary
movies.summary: Scientists are learning that each bee in a hive is an individual, with its own personality. Follows the circle of life of the honeybees.

movies.title: Dear Audrey
movies.summary: A devoted activist filmmaker sets aside his camera to care for his wife through Alzheimer's, reflecting on their shared past of activism, art, and adventure while helping their autistic daughter cope with the changes.

movies.title: Shingeki no Kyojin: The Last Attack
movies.summary: The fate of the world hangs in the balance as Eren unleashes the ultimate power of the Titans. With a burning determination to eliminate all who threaten Eldia, he leads an unstoppable army of Colossal Titans towards Marley.

movies.title: Zombieland: Double Tap
movies.summary: Columbus, Tallahassee, Wichita, and Little Rock move to the American heartland as they face off against evolved zombies, fellow survivors, and the growing pains of the snarky makeshift family.

movies.title: Upgrade
movies.summary: Set in the near-future, technology controls nearly all aspects of life. But when the world of Grey, a self-labeled technophobe, is turned upside down, his only hope for revenge is an experimental computer chip implant.

movies.title: A Quiet Place Part II
movies.summary: Following the events at home, the Abbott family now face the terrors of the outside world. Forced to venture into the unknown, they realize the creatures that hunt by sound are not the only threats lurking beyond the sand path.

movies.title: Prey
movies.summary: Naru, a skilled warrior of the Comanche Nation, fights to protect her tribe against one of the first highly-evolved Predators to land on Earth.

movies.title: Annabelle: Creation
movies.summary: Twelve years after the tragic death of their little girl, a doll-maker and his wife welcome a nun and several girls from a shuttered orphanage into their home, where they become the target of the doll-maker's possessed creation, Annabelle.

movies.title: The Dark Tower
movies.summary: A boy haunted by visions of a dark tower from a parallel reality teams up with the tower's disillusioned guardian to stop an evil warlock known as the Man in Black who plans to use the boy to destroy the tower and open the gates of Hell.

movies.title: Busanhaeng
movies.summary: While a zombie virus breaks out in South Korea, passengers struggle to survive on the train from Seoul to Busan.

movies.title: The First Purge
movies.summary: America's third political party, the New Founding Fathers of America, comes to power and conducts an experiment: no laws for 12 hours on Staten Island. No one has to stay on the island, but $5,000 is given to anyone who does.

movies.title: The Conjuring 2
movies.summary: Ed and Lorraine Warren travel to North London to help a single mother raising four children alone in a house plagued by a supernatural spirit.

movies.title: How to Train Your Dragon
movies.summary: A hapless young Viking who aspires to hunt dragons becomes the unlikely friend of a young dragon himself, and learns there may be more to the creatures than he assumed.

movies.title: Bird Box
movies.summary: Five years after an ominous unseen presence drives most of society to suicide, a mother and her two children make a desperate bid to reach safety.

movies.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
movies.summary: Dracula and his friends try to bring out the monster in his half human, half vampire grandson in order to keep Mavis from leaving the hotel.

movies.title: The Last Witch Hunter
movies.summary: The last witch hunter is all that stands between humanity and the combined forces of the most horrifying witches in history.

movies.title: Venom: The Last Dance
movies.summary: Eddie Brock and Venom must make a devastating decision as they're pursued by a mysterious military man and alien monsters from Venom's home world.

movies.title: Justice League Dark
movies.summary: Beings with supernatural powers join together to fight against supernatural villains. This team of supernatural beings include John Constantine, Zatanna and Jason Blood also known as the demon Etrigan.
